titles.title: SUCCESS Act of 2026
SUCCESS Act of 2026
Support for Universities and Colleges to Champion the Educational Success of Survivors Act of 2026
To establish a grant program for institutions of higher education to implement patient-centered academic counseling services for student survivors of sexual assault and other violence.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Education and Workforce.

bill.summary:
Support for Universities and Colleges to Champion the Educational Success of Survivors Act of 2026 or the SUCCESS Act of 2026
This bill requires the Department of Education to award competitive grants to eligible institutions of higher education for implementing patient-centered academic counseling services and other services for students who are survivors of sexual assault and other violence.
